releases.title: A CLI that fits any window
changes: The CLI picks the biggest header that fits your window: the full cat and name, the cat with a compact name, or a small two-line cat.
Resizing or moving the window redraws everything at the new size and keeps your menu selection, what you were typing and the results you were reading.
Resizing during the intro skips straight to the finished banner instead of smearing animation frames down the screen.

releases.title: An animated CLI
changes: The CLI intro now decrypts the cat and the TraceWatch name out of noise, sweeps a light down the logo, glitches the name in and makes the cat blink.
Animated loading wave with a live timer, results that cascade in, a risk bar that fills and counts up, and a wipe curtain when you quit.
Every visitor sees the "Now in your terminal" introduction once; a single browser flag remembers it, with no search data.
Turn CLI animations off with --no-anim or the NO_MOTION environment variable.

releases.title: Main update: the TraceWatch CLI

featured.title: TraceWatch, now in your terminal
featured.description: A full command-line app with the TraceWatch cat in ASCII art. Pick what to search with the arrow keys: email exposure, usernames on 42 sites, passwords, phone numbers, Discord accounts or the breach catalogue. When you quit, it wipes the terminal so nothing you searched stays on screen.

changes: New Open CLI button in the header opens the CLI in a terminal window on this computer.
Run it any time with ./start.sh cli, start.bat cli or npm run cli; one-off scans work too, e.g. npm run cli -- username torvalds.
Password checks in the CLI hash locally and send only 5 characters, exactly like the website.
The CLI starts the TraceWatch server for you if it is not already running.
Big releases can now show a featured card like this one.

releases.title: 4K wallpapers
changes: Three free 4K wallpapers made from the TraceWatch background: the cat between the hands, hands only, and a clean version.
Grab them from the v0.3.0 GitHub release or the wallpapers folder in the repository.
Release notes in the app can now include a download button, like the one below.

releases.title: One-command setup and update alerts
changes: Start TraceWatch with one command on Windows, macOS and Linux, or with Docker.
Your instance now tells you when a new version is on GitHub, and shows what changed after you update.
Released under the GNU AGPL-3.0 open-source license.

releases.title: Username search
changes: New Username tab checks 42 social, developer, gaming, creative and community sites for a public profile.
Every site detector is verified against real and missing names; blocked or odd answers show as unknown, never as found.
Discord avatars and banners are streamed through TraceWatch so your browser never caches them.

releases.title: First release
changes: Email breach search merged across XposedOrNot, LeakCheck and Hudson Rock infostealer logs, with optional Have I Been Pwned.
Password, phone and Discord account checks.
Searchable catalogue of every known breach and a no-login dashboard.
No cookies, no storage: leave the page and everything you searched is gone.
